description: Unit tests for DNS record parsing in Chromium project, testing RecordParsed class functionality including record creation, equality, and handling of various RDATA scenarios.

classes.name: RecordParsed
classes.description: Represents a parsed DNS record, with methods for creation, comparison, and data access.

methods.name: CreateFrom
methods.description: Creates a RecordParsed object from a DNS parser and timestamp.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the DNS name of the record.

methods.name: rdata
methods.description: Returns the RDATA of the record.

methods.name: rdata_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the RDATA for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Compares two DNS records for equality, with options for mDNS.
